{{Quote|My sister, Kostanza, was Bron's mother! ''[sic]'' I am the closest blood relative and, by rights, should have first claim as boy's regent! But I will forego that. I will even accept your brother-in-law, Orom Malvern, as regent! But I will not accept ''you'', my Lord Borgin!|The Serennian count|<ref name="AOTE2" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''individual''' served as [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] and Head of one of the six [[Great Houses/Legends|Great Houses]] of [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Shortly after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], the [[Unidentified Serennian count's father|previous head]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by his own son, when [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] drove the scions of the Great Houses of Serenno to [[Cleansing of Serenno|murder]] their [[Parent/Legends|fathers]] and take their place.<ref name="AOTE2" />

In [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]], the [[Count/Legends|Count]] was present aboard the [[House Dooku|Dooku]] airship, the [[Windrunner/Legends|''Windrunner'']], during the [[Dooku regency conclave|regency conclave]] of the Great Houses that convened to elect a new [[Regent/Legends|regent]] for [[Bron Dooku]]. The Count voluntarily renounced their first claim of hereditary right to regency, and also refused to elect the Empire's first choice, Lord [[Rodas Borgin]] of [[House Borgin/Legends|House Borgin]], preferring Lord [[Orom Malvern]] as the new regent. In the midst of negotiations, the airship was [[Attack on the Windrunner|attacked]] by a pirate airship known as the ''[[Bloodskull]]''. Commanded by [[Aveca Dunn|Vex]], operating under the employment of Rodas Borgin, the pirates attempted to capture Bron Dooku.<ref name="AOTE2" />

Following the apparent death of Bron, [[Orom Malvern]] was named the new Count of Serenno with support of both the Great Houses, the new Count [[Pero Borgin]], and the [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the Imperial [[Serenno fleet|fleet]].<ref name="AOTE5">[[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 5|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 5]]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets 2|''Agent of the Empire – Hard Targets'' 2]], [[Kostanza Dooku|Kostanza]] was mistakenly referred to as the mother of [[Bron Dooku]]; she was in fact his grandmother.<ref name="AOTE2" />
